  "fix": {"action": "change_runtime_flag", "target": "--repeat-penalty", "value": "1.0"},
  "rationale": "The server is launched with --repeat-penalty 1.5 (sane range is 1.0-1.1) and the request stacks presence_penalty 1.5 on top, so any token already used gets hammered. The output shows the exact fingerprint of that: the model writes 'for j from range(6)' because 'in' was already spent on the first loop, opens loop headers whose bodies never materialize because reusing indentation and identifiers is penalized, and drifts into long novel-vocabulary comments instead of reusable code structure. Other candidates don't fit: the prompt is 27 tokens with a 254-token stop-finished reply (no truncation or context shift), the English is fluent (no template or EOS corruption), and Q4_0 weights plus q8_0 KV cache don't selectively delete the keyword 'in' at this short length. Dropping the server repeat penalty to ~1.0 (and removing the request's presence_penalty) restores normal token reuse."
}
